verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a government filing portal, but the evidence never documents a batch or bulk action that runs across many items at once. The statement that multiple filings on multiple entities can be processed through one Online Account describes account scope, not a simultaneous bulk operation. "Data and Image Subscriptions" is only a bare link title with no description of bulk action capability, so it is adjacent at best and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
